{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id rows, keeping the one with the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the data is now one row per patient
print(f"Number of unique patients: {trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of the key variables
print("\nDistribution of arm:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nDistribution of sex:")
print(trial_df['sex'].value_counts())

print("\nDistribution of severity:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

# Check if arm and severity are confounded
print("\nCross-tabulation of arm and severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity']))"}
